items.t: 30 houses sold in Vedder Crossing, Chilliwack at a median of $667,000 (middle half $569,250 to $759,500). A typical house in Vedder Crossing, Chilliwack spent 28 days on the market and closed at 97.6% of the asking price.

In Vedder Crossing, Chilliwack, townhomes sold at a median of $512,500 across 24 sales, and the middle half closed between $490,000 and $534,000. The median townhome sat 22 days and sold for 97.5% of list.

How Vedder Crossing compares with the rest of Sardis

items.t: Houses in Vedder Crossing have the lowest median of the 7 Sardis sub-areas, $667,000, below Chilliwack River Valley at $865,000; the highest is Garrison Crossing at $1,192,500.

Of 6 Sardis sub-areas with 5 or more townhome sales, Vedder Crossing ranks second lowest at $512,500; the range is $389,950 (Sardis West Vedder) to $650,000 (South Sardis). Sardis West Vedder ($389,950) sits just below and Garrison Crossing ($615,000) sits just above.
